## Claim Classes (reference)

- **C1** Factual capability — file + test path required
- **C2** Technical / security — file + test + threat-model entry
- **C3** Compliance / regulatory — regulation citation + ISMS evidence
- **C4** Customer / traction — signed customer reference required
- **C5** Pricing / commercial terms — must match `src/pages/Billing.jsx` + `governance/10` flag registry
- **C6** Aspirational — explicit forward-looking labeling
